changelog: Subtitle burn-in validates and normalizes video and subtitle sources to credential-free HTTP(S) before export
Subtitle payloads decode UTF-8, UTF-16LE, and UTF-16BE byte-order marks before parsing
Mislabeled HTML or login bodies are rejected even when the server omits the HTML content type
WebVTT NOTE, STYLE, and REGION blocks are skipped completely instead of becoming rendered cues
Subtitle cue character-budget accounting is linear rather than repeatedly summing all prior cues
message: CS3M v666 — robustere Subtitle-Quellen und WebVTT-Verarbeitung
